2226-4576-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-4576-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Fleetfoot Panther by paying its mana cost.
When Fleetfoot Panther enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

4279-5687-6578--216.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5687-6578--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3968-4050-4078-7286.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-7286.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, South Wind Avatar triggers three times, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

710-1703-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

413-719-3413.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Xenograft, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

997-4871-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, Pitiless Plunderer, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat

1978-3430-4045-5793.description:
Activate Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping it, adding six mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Ur-Golem's Eye which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4050-4550-5567-7824--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4050-4550-5567-7824--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

2043-6791-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-6791-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

670-1008-1619-4142.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1008-1619-4142.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Undermountain Adventurer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Undermountain Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Undermountain Adventurer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

933-4377-7757-7758.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
933-4377-7757-7758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Conjurer's Closet.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Walk the Aeons.
Walk the Aeons's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

647-2034-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more oil counters on it

3120-3923-4050-7639.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation by paying {U} due to Mindsplice Apparatus.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

240-803-997.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Arcane Adaptation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-803-997.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1322-1563-3899-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2060-3750-6798-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-3750-6798-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

2457-4094-4289-5295.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2457-4094-4289-5295.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-3228-5295-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3228-5295-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

2281-3967-6598.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting General Leo Cristophe.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing General Leo Cristophe.
When General Leo Cristophe dies, Saffi triggers, returning General Leo Cristophe from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When General Leo Cristophe enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1399-1606-1671-5929.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

856-2279-5256-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

215-4231-5444-6441.description:
Cast Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Carnage Interpreter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight Clue, Food and Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B/R}{B/R}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Carnage Interpreter to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1621-4598-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
1621-4598-4605.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-1879-2034.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1247-5536-5614.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Bighorner Rancher and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-5536-5614.description:
Activate Rex using Bighorner Rancher's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

390-3719-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
390-3719-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Hulking Metamorph has a power of at least 2.
390-3719-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Hulking Metamorph and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Hulking Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Hulking Metamorph to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Hulking Metamorph enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Hulking Metamorph by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

511-817-1270-3334-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

3192-4050-4613-5212.notablePrerequisites: Kresh the Bloodbraided has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3192-4050-4613-5212.description:
Activate Kresh the Bloodbraided using Ulasht's ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
When the Saproling dies, Kresh the Bloodbraided triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

1558-1770-2334-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
Myr Battlesphere's first ability triggers twice and Soulherder's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve both Myr Battlesphere triggers, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1971-2781-4344.manaNeeded: {6}{G}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1971-2781-4344.description:
Cast Yannik either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Yannik enters the battlefield, exiling Felidar Guardian and putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Cast Lumbering Battlement by paying {4}{W}.
Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, exiling Yannik.
Yannik leaves the battlefield, returning Felidar Guardian from exile to the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Lumbering Battlement leaves and enters the battlefield, returning Yannik from exile to the battlefield, and triggering Lumbering Battlement's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Yannik enters the battlefield, exiling Felidar Guardian and putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Yannik.
Repeat from step 5.

864-2034-4872-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kenrith's last ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

598-1430-2452-2523.notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least three loyalty counters on it.
598-1430-2452-2523.description:
Activate Liliana's third ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mirror Image by paying {2}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put the original Ratadrabik into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each other copy of Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ratadrabik that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Cast Ratadrabik from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 3.

3492-3609-5105.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3492-3609-5105.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Coretapper from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Coretapper's ability, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.

1518-1987-3573-4125.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.You control at least two artifacts.
1518-1987-3573-4125.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

1996-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer's ability by paying {2}{C}, blinking Brood Monitor.
Brood Monitor enters the battlefield tapped, triggering itself, creating three 1/1 Eldrazi Scion tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
